Hi Olga / Neha,

Thanks again for selecting RedTeam Secure for AcmePay's November engagement. Per our phone call, we want to confirm the tentative test window (Nov 23-27) and collect access information so we can prep credentials and our jumpbox. Attached is a short access matrix we ask you to pre-fill (hostname, environment, credential type, contact).

Two quick clarifications from our side:
- We plan external black-box + authenticated web app testing; any internal network tests require a separate approval (let us know if you want it in-scope).
- We'll need a dedicated service account for API key validation and a temporary SSH key for the staging bastion host.

Can you confirm who the day-of points of contact are and whether the staging environment will be reachable over the public IP range listed in the matrix? If you prefer, we can shift to Nov 30-Dec 4.

Regards,
Tim Barnes

Perfect — thanks for the NATs and details. Two follow-ups before we drop credentials into Vault:
1) Scope tweak request from our tech lead: include OAuth token replay testing for the public auth endpoints (we'll keep brute-force & credential stuffing out of scope). This requires temporary client credentials to perform authorized requests against staging. Please confirm OK.
2) Can AcmePay confirm that logging for the staging auth endpoint includes request body retention for 7 days; we may ask for specific logs as part of evidence.

Also attaching our redteam_statement_of_work.pdf for signature; we can DocuSign the SOW and start the non-disclosure exchange.

Tim
